bibl.title: Mímesis de un discurso judicial: Uso -¿y abuso?- de la retórica en el mimo II de Hero(n)das.
bibl.seg: Claudia N. Fernández, Mímesis de un discurso judicial: Uso -¿y abuso?- de la retórica en el mimo II de Hero(n)das.
bibl.note: The judicial speech of Battaros - the only protagonist of Herodas' mime 2 - is a sounding board for rhetoric topoi of Attic oratory. To go deeply into its connection with the forensic genre, the article evaluates to what extent this peculiar rhetor succeeds or fails in his persuasive purpose in the light of the assumptions provided by the Rhetoric to Alexander, but, above all, the Aristotelian Rhetoric.
